bio_en: Galust Torlakian, known as Vahagn, was born in 1867 in the Kiushana quarter of Yomra near Trabzon, a district where Armenians had long served as armed guards of the Shatir-zade beys. During the disastrous days of 1895 he and a few comrades protected the terrified villagers, and though repeatedly searched and arrested he could not be convicted, being articulate and literate in Turkish law. For twenty years he led the ARF organisation of the district. On 15 September 1909, returning from the mill with his daughter, he was shot dead from ambush.
